title: Dungeon Dash
logline: Hack and slash through procedurally generated dungeon rooms — clear every enemy, grab the key, and find the exit before the darkness swallows you.
visualStyle: Dark stone dungeon aesthetic with procedural tiled floors (dark gray/brown rectangles). Torchlight glow around the player (radial gradient overlay). Enemies are vivid colored shapes — green slimes (circles), red imps (triangles), purple wraiths (diamonds). Walls are dark rectangles. Items glow with golden light.
coreMechanic: Room-based arena combat. The player enters one room at a time, each containing enemies. Player moves in 8 directions (WASD), attacks with Space (slash arc in facing direction), and dodge-rolls with Shift (0.3s dash with invincibility, 1s cooldown). Killing all enemies drops a key. The key unlocks the door to the next room. Health does not regenerate between rooms (rare health potions have 20% spawn chance per room).

controls.action: Dodge roll (0.3s dash with invincibility, 1s cooldown)

progression: Room 1: 3 slimes. Room 2: 5 slimes. Room 3: 3 slimes + 2 imps. Room 4+: Increasing counts, wraiths at room 6+. Enemy speed +5%/room. Every 5 rooms = boss room (large enemy, more HP, attack patterns).
scoring: +10/slime, +25/imp, +50/wraith, +200/boss. +100/room cleared. Time bonus for fast clears. Combo for kills within 2s of each other.

screens.intro: DUNGEON DASH in rugged stone-textured font. Flickering torchlight. Sword icon. Controls. High score. Press SPACE to Enter.
screens.hud: Health bar top-left (red), Score top-right, Room number center-top, Dodge cooldown bottom-center, Key icon when collected.
screens.pause: PAUSED, score + room number, ESC to Resume.
screens.gameOver: YOU HAVE FALLEN with red flash. Rooms cleared, enemies killed, score. High score. Click to Try Again.
